body: Never forget when a fan asked Cardi B for $20 during an Instagram Live and she immediately flipped the request back on them “Can you send me $20 and buy my CD? I’m broke too,” she joked, leaving the chat laughing. The exchange was a perfect example of Cardi’s quick, unfiltered humor and a funny callback to the days when artists would ask fans to support their music by picking up a CD.

source_caption_text:
Never forget when a fan asked Cardi B for $20 during an Instagram Live and she immediately flipped the request back on them 😂

“Can you send me $20 and buy my CD? I’m broke too,” she joked, leaving the chat laughing. The exchange was a perfect example of Cardi’s quick, unfiltered humor and a funny callback to the days when artists would ask fans to support their music by picking up a CD. 💿😭

Even with a huge career behind her, Cardi can still turn a random fan interaction into a moment people remember. Would you have sent her the $20 or bought the album? 👀
